name: cmarks
title: cmarks
description: Search and open Markdown files from your cmarks workspaces, reopen recent files, and send Finder selections to cmarks.
author: changhyun_yoo

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Markdown Files
commands.subtitle: cmarks
commands.description: Search Markdown files in every cmarks workspace and open one in cmarks.

commands.name: recent
commands.title: Open Recent File
commands.subtitle: cmarks
commands.description: Reopen a Markdown file you read recently in cmarks.

commands.name: open-finder-selection
commands.title: Open Finder Selection in cmarks
commands.subtitle: cmarks
commands.description: Open the files and folders selected in the Finder with cmarks. Folders become workspaces.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
